reviews.title: So frustrated with the simple avatar creator I gave up!
reviews.pros: So many avatars to choose from! I really wanted this software to work. And it looked like it might be promising but I don’t think they offer product integration.
reviews.cons: I could not figure out how to delete some add-ons I was trying out on my avatar. There’s no delete button on these “options”, it just gives you ways to edit them- kind of. I finally gave up and tried starting over with a new avatar- but it wouldn’t let me. The most frustration I’ve experienced with AI software yet. I can’t believe it’s at the top of all these AI lists. Oh! And whatever you do, don’t hit the ◀️ button on the top left. That’s only going to send you back to the sign in page, and that’ll take 3 - 4 minutes while it’s loading to do that. With all the $ these companies make, it might do them some good to invest in hiring a UX designer so they know what their customers are dealing with?🤷‍♀️
reviews.overall: With the endless alternatives for AI software available I’m shocked they’re so highly recommended. It’s really easy to sign up and they don’t need a credit card which is very cool. But I couldn’t even get my avatar started, and now I’m signed up to receive their emails. So…
